t.zh: 类型还能依赖一个值。Vec n 是长 n 的向量的类型，长度写在类型里。这里只记长度，所以一个 Vec n 的证明项就是一个长 n 的向量。
t.en: A type can depend on a value. Vec n is the type of vectors n long: the length is in the type. Only the length is kept here, so a proof term of Vec n is a vector n long.

t.zh: 已知 vnil 是空向量；vcons 在长 x 的向量前面接上一个，得到长 S x 的向量。vcons 是「对所有 x」，但 x 不用写：核看它拿到的向量多长，就知道 x 是几。
t.en: The given vnil is the empty vector; vcons puts one in front of a vector x long to give one S x long. vcons is “for all x”, yet x is not written: the kernel sees how long the vector it gets is, and so knows x.

after.zh: 结果的类型依赖参数的值，这样的类型叫<wiki-ref to="dependent"></wiki-ref>；由别处读出、不必写的参数叫<wiki-ref to="implicit"></wiki-ref>。
after.en: A type that depends on the value of an argument is a <wiki-ref to="dependent"></wiki-ref>; an argument read off elsewhere and not written is an <wiki-ref to="implicit"></wiki-ref>.
